commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files --hidden -g '"'!'"\\.git/**' -g '"'!__pycache__/**'"' && cat README.md delivery.md docs/task-completion.md docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md && git diff -- README.md delivery.md tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py && git rev-parse HEAD && shasum tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('README.md'), Path('delivery.md'), Path('docs/task-completion.md')]
for page in pages:
    text = page.read_text()
    assert 'work/investigation/repeated-completion.md' not in text, page
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', text):
        path, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        linked = page.parent / path
        assert linked.exists(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = [re.sub(r'["'^'"\\w\\s-]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in re.findall(r'"'^#+ (.+)$'"', linked.read_text(), re.M)]
            assert anchor in headings, (page, target)
assert not Path('docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md').exists()
print('Documentation links and investigation-record removal verified.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && shasum tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py && cat delivery.md docs/task-completion.md'
